title: The Spark: the man who crowned himself

segments.text: It is December second, eighteen oh four, inside Notre-Dame cathedral in Paris.
The Pope has come all the way from Rome to crown the new emperor.
But Napoleon takes the crown from the Pope's hands,
and places it on his own head.
Just five years earlier, he was a general who had seized power in a coup.
Now he is emperor of the French, with a message for every king in Europe:
nobody makes me. I make myself.
Within a year, he would win his greatest battle at Austerlitz.
Within ten, he would rule most of the continent.
And the rulers who had mocked him would spend years trying to bring him down.

verify: 2 Dec 1804 coronation; Napoleon placed crown on his own head (Pope present)
